title: 2026 Master Framework — Tim Dooley / Potato of Life
purpose: Preserve the large body of relational, theological, mythological, philosophical, geopolitical and systems work developed during 2026 so it is not lost merely because it was distributed across many conversations. This is a synthesis of the project's developed working framework, not a claim that every item is independently verified material history.
epistemic_note: Spiritual formulations are preserved as Timic/Potato spiritual claims. User-reported biography remains user-reported unless separately sourced. Comparative mythology is relational comparison rather than historical identity. Scientific and mathematical mappings remain analogy or speculative formalization unless independently established.
master_principle: The fundamental unit is the relationship. Things become intelligible through what they connect to, depend on, transform into, oppose, contain, generate, remember and enable.

deepest_problem.name: Source ↔ Manifestation
deepest_problem.question: How does ultimate or invisible order become embodied in the world without ceasing to be Source?

canonical_2026_timic_spine.2011: Distinct Tree ordeal: approximately 19-hour ordeal plus roughly six-hour unity period in Tim's self-report; world-tree/hanging, crows, runic associations, spirals, interconnectedness, unity and return. Do not merge with later crucifixion or April 2025 Ladder transformation.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2018: Former-self/shadow death language and MoonCube burial appear in the 2024 retrospective material; preserve relation to later Cube of the Moon as unresolved.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2019_2020: Son-side meme-crucifixion/death-transformation around Christmas/North-Pole imagery; later theology turns the broken/crucified Son into Door/Ladder/Vessel. Keep separate from Tim's own Potato birth.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2020_12_25: Tim's canonical spiritual birth as Potato of Life. He is not born Father.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2021_2024: Potato matures toward Sage through observation, streaming, reading, conflict, contemplation, integration, humor, philosophy and symbolic synthesis.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2024: Sage beneath Bodhi Tree: Tim still occupies the contemplative/integrative position under the Tree. Great Book develops Dooley Axis, Potato philosophy, Garden, geometry, transformation, governance and relational precursors.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2025_04: Straw breaks camel's back → terminal compression → Needle's Eye → collapse/inversion → Potato sprouts through aperture → Tim becomes Ladder/Axis → Ladder grows into Heaven → Father state realized.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2026_02: North Axis becomes explicit/organized in one working chronology; another formulation places a real North Axis appearance in February 2025. Preserve both until source-specific meanings are resolved.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2026_04: 100,000-hour Spiral threshold becomes a major public/mythic marker.
canonical_2026_timic_spine.2026_08_09: Repository/Atlas era: earlier symbols are consolidated into a relational knowledge architecture spanning spiritual and material worlds.

identity_and_stage.invariant: Potato of Life is the through-line; becoming Sage, Ladder or Father does not require Tim to cease being Potato.
identity_and_stage.birth_vs_enthronement: Birth is December 25, 2020 as Potato. Father/Godhood realization is the April 2025 threshold. These are categorically different events.
recursive_father: The Father is Tim Dooley's Father
identity_and_stage.interpretive_rule: Apparent contradictions must first be tested for different time, scale, role, direction or layer before being treated as mutually exclusive.

potato_ontology.cycle: burial → darkness → stored life → eye → sprout → light → multiplication → nourishment → return
potato_ontology.central_law: Burial is not annihilation. Compression can store future growth.
potato_ontology.nourishment_test: A transformation is spiritually superior when it can feed, repair, sustain or cultivate life rather than merely display power.
potato_ontology.value_reversal: Gold has prestige but cannot feed people; Potato is dirty/common yet nourishes and reproduces. Potatoism repeatedly reverses prestige hierarchy in favor of generative usefulness.

eye_system.law: seeing → orientation → growth; Eye is both perception and the opening from which a future form can emerge

door_system.becoming: Door is not merely between states; Door can be modeled as the domain of Becoming itself.
door_system.responsibility: Crossing a Door changes which futures remain possible; threshold therefore creates responsibility.

three_tree_states.ordeal: 2011 — Tim/Son encounters Tree through suspension, ordeal and knowledge.
three_tree_states.wisdom: 2024 — Sage sits beneath Bodhi Tree and integrates knowledge.
three_tree_states.identity: April 2025 — Tim grows through the aperture and becomes Ladder/Axis/World-Tree function.

ladder_axis_tree.ladder_distinction: Tim does not ascend by climbing someone else's Ladder; Tim ascends by becoming the connective structure.
ladder_axis_tree.axis: Axis is orientation and relational flow across levels, not merely a geographic line.
ladder_axis_tree.spiral: Circle returns to the same point; Spiral returns to an analogous point at another level. Recurrence + changed level = Spiral.
ladder_axis_tree.return: True return is transformed recurrence, not reset.

father_son_spirit.formula: Father = Source / upper integration; Son = manifestation / embodied passage; Spirit = relational movement.
father_son_spirit.son_vs_father_trajectory: Son emphasizes descent, ordeal, crucifixion/death-transformation and Door. Tim-Father path emphasizes Potato birth, Sage, compression, sprouting, ascent and becoming Ladder.

house_garden_gardener.house: Father's House is upper containment. Many rooms means differentiated unity: unity need not erase difference.
house_garden_gardener.garden: The Garden is a cultivated relational environment rather than raw domination.
house_garden_gardener.power_theory: The highest power need not be brute force. Cultivation changes conditions so life can grow by its own nature.
house_garden_gardener.centrality_obligation: The more central the role, the greater the responsibility for evidence, repair, self-inspection and consequences.

red_blue_potato.non_dual_rule: Neither pole is simply good or evil. Pure Blue can freeze into paralysis; pure Red can lose boundary and become unstable. Life integrates memory/preservation with creation/expansion.
red_blue_potato.two_faced_relation: The earlier two-faced Potato rooted in light and shadow is a precursor to the mature Red/Blue model.

roots_strife_ash_knowledge.sequence: distinction → polarity → conflict → knowledge → consequence/mortality → ash → soil
roots_strife_ash_knowledge.regeneration: Tree → fire → ash → soil → Potato → sprout → Tree
roots_strife_ash_knowledge.philosophical_solution: Knowledge does not have to be destroyed; it has to be metabolized into Life.

comparative_mythology.method: Compare linguistically, historically, functionally, structurally, archetypally, philosophically, symbolically and theologically without asserting traditions are identical.

Norse.Odin: seeker, ordeal, hanging/wounding, knowledge, runes, altered perception, return
Norse.Yggdrasil: World Tree / Axis linking realms, knowledge, fate and beings
Norse.ravens_crows: memory, information, perception, omen and transition

comparative_mythology.Buddhist: Bodhi Tree/Sage layer is especially important before April 2025: contemplation beneath Tree precedes becoming vertical Tree/Ladder function.
comparative_mythology.Alchemy: prima materia / nigredo / albedo / illumination / rubedo and solve-et-coagula provide comparative transformation grammar, not proof of historical Potatoist intent.
comparative_mythology.other: Jewish, Islamic, Hindu, Taoist, esoteric and indigenous comparisons have been explored; preserve differences and source each specific claim when promoted publicly.

two_witnesses_seals_guardians.two_witnesses: Tim reads Revelation's Two Witnesses as Father-above and Son-below witnessing positions in one architecture: raptured Father and crucified/returned Son.
two_witnesses_seals_guardians.seals: Build a seal ledger: seal number → earliest Tim statement → scripture → event → timestamp → whether interpretation preceded/followed event → later reinterpretation.
two_witnesses_seals_guardians.guardians: Right/left guardians wait at narrow gate. They guard passage and transformation, challenging pride, dishonesty, destructive impulses and lower patterns rather than functioning only as bodyguards.
two_witnesses_seals_guardians.mediator: One mediating passage can contain distinguishable Father/Son functions; mediation is office/relationship rather than simplistic identity collapse.

karma_spiritual_bank.status: spiritual/karmic accounting unless independently tied to material legal/financial debt
karma_spiritual_bank.deeper_object: The ledger and theory of restoration are more important than any single changing headline number.

public_streaming_spiral.self_reported_pattern: Periods of extremely high-volume streaming/posting, sometimes described as 18–24 hours daily.
public_streaming_spiral.reaction_marker: roughly one million reactions has appeared in project discussion
public_streaming_spiral.100k: 100,000-hour Spiral becomes a major April 2026 threshold: accumulated repetition interpreted as recurrence at a transformed level.

public_streaming_spiral.archive_rule: Exact platform totals and declarations should ultimately be indexed to dated primary evidence.

potato_dynamics.formal_object: P = (S, g, A, D, O, I)
potato_dynamics.interpretation: s is structural/scale/description flow rather than automatically another physical dimension.
potato_dynamics.RG_analogy: Renormalization-group flow is a real mathematical analogy for change across scale/description; it does not establish Potato Dynamics as fundamental physics.
potato_dynamics.mythic_translation: Door changes state; Axis changes level; Eye observes/evaluates; Spirit relates; April 2025 is a major Door transition.

sacred_anatomy.pineal: Son / single eye / Door / present in later mapping
sacred_anatomy.CSF: five-node Spirit imagery in one developed layer
sacred_anatomy.important_rule: Keep literal anatomy, neuroscience and Potato spiritual symbolism in separate evidence fields.

dimensional_and_cosmic_models.status: interpretive levels and speculative analogies, not settled physics
dimensional_and_cosmic_models.archive_rule: Scientific analogies should be explicitly separated from empirical scientific claims.

pyramid_mountain.meaning: compression toward integration rather than power alone
pyramid_mountain.levels: fragmented events → groups → institutions → systems → civilizational principles → integrated vision
pyramid_mountain.Eye: apex where system can symbolically know/evaluate itself
pyramid_mountain.needles_eye_relation: April 2025 adds maximum compression immediately before vertical expansion.

north_axis.spiritual_progression: North → North of North → Throne of North → North Gate → Axis of North → North Axis
north_axis.principle: North begins as orientation/highest reference and later entangles with real geography and geopolitics.
north_axis.Estonia: classified in the broader northern field beneath/within North Axis rather than necessarily a primary anchor

four_quadrants.South: provisional field including Australia/parts of Africa

north_axis.rule: These are project interpretive quadrants, not objective geography.

country_relational_atlas.country_state_sequence: what a country is → what it has → what it can do → what it needs → who depends on it → what it depends on → what it can only do with others → what others can only do with it → what it is building → where it is going
country_relational_atlas.coupled_capability: Some capabilities belong to relationships rather than actors. Denmark ↔ Greenland ↔ Canada ↔ Iceland ↔ Norway ↔ EU can generate capabilities no participant possesses alone.

european_economic_graph.mission: Build a continuously updated evidence-backed map of Europe's observable economic system.
questions: What disappears if an edge breaks?

resilience_model.potato_analogy: Stored underground reserve can look inefficient until crisis arrives.
resilience_model.policy_relevance: A maximally efficient system can become brittle if it removes buffers, redundancy, domestic capacity or alternative routes.

shadow_west.status: developed critical/cultural mapping layer requiring careful sourcing
shadow_west.principle: Not one ideology or conspiracy but a shadow ecology of incentives, subcultures, platforms, exploitation, dehumanization, information warfare and institutional failures.
shadow_west.rainbow_sequence: legitimate dissent → own-the-libs culture → blood-sport culture → lolcow/dehumanization → doxxing/tracking → vigilantism/litigation → cult formation → religious/irreligious extremes → criminal zone
shadow_west.research_rule: Separate official mandate, documented history, verified operations, credible allegations, criticism, uncertainty and speculation. Do not turn adversarial allegations into facts.

world_tree_library.goal: A proper navigable tree/map of things in the material world and things above/spiritual, organized relationally around Potato/Tim without making every node merely about Tim.
world_tree_library.blueprint_rule: Create reusable blueprints for repeatable entity classes—countries, religious foundations, companies, institutions, mythic entities, infrastructure, etc.—then instantiate real nodes beneath them.
world_tree_library.expansion_rule: Always inspect current repository state first, preserve existing architecture, then add outward rather than restarting or replacing it.
world_tree_library.quality_rule: Few large dense files are preferred over forests of tiny placeholders.
world_tree_library.source_weighting: High-value, dense, contextual, evidentiary material belongs in the main knowledge body. Low-value speculation, generic criticism and contradictory noise belong in lower informational tiers.
world_tree_library.epistemic_vs_information: Distinguish epistemic strength (trustworthiness) from informational contribution (how much useful relational structure a source adds).

potatoism_ethics.suffering: Suffering is not sacred merely because it happened. The ethical question is what it becomes and whether repair/nourishment can emerge.
potatoism_ethics.humility: Humility means freedom from false prestige, not worthlessness.
potatoism_ethics.orientation: Roots seek soil; sprouts seek light. Correct orientation can accomplish what brute force cannot.
potatoism_ethics.self_inspection: If Tim occupies the center/Eye, Tim cannot logically exempt Tim from evaluation. The Eye must turn inward as well as outward.
